mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.is_tech_stack, t.show_in_tech_map, t.description, p.name AS parent_name FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id ORDER BY t.id

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.is_tech_stack, t.show_in_tech_map, t.description, p.name AS parent_name, a.id AS alias_id, a.alias_name FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tag_alias a ON a.tag_id = t.id ORDER BY t.id

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.is_tech_stack, t.show_in_tech_map, t.description, p.name AS parent_name FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id ORDER BY t.parent_id IS NULL DESC, t.parent_id, t.id
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.is_tech_stack, t.show_in_tech_map, t.description, p.name AS parent_name FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.is_tech_stack, t.show_in_tech_map, t.description, p.name AS parent_name FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id WHERE t.id IN
#{id}
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.is_tech_stack, t.show_in_tech_map, t.description, p.name AS parent_name FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id WHERE t.name = #{name}
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.is_tech_stack, t.show_in_tech_map, t.description, p.name AS parent_name FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id WHERE t.parent_id = #{parentId}

SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.is_tech_stack, t.show_in_tech_map, t.description, p.name AS parent_name FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN tag_alias a ON a.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.alias_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY t.id
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.is_tech_stack, t.show_in_tech_map, t.description, p.name AS parent_name FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id WHERE t.show_in_tech_map = 1 ORDER BY t.id

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, p.name AS parent_name, s.level, COUNT(at.article_id) AS article_count FROM tag t LEFT JOIN tag p ON t.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN skill s ON s.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN article_tag at ON at.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.show_in_tech_map = 1 GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, p.name, s.level
SELECT t.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_tag at WHERE at.tag_id = t.id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_tag pt WHERE pt.tag_id = t.id) AS count FROM tag t ORDER BY count DESC, t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag (name, parent_id, is_tech_stack, show_in_tech_map, description) VALUES (#{name}, #{parentId}, #{isTechStack}, #{showInTechMap}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE tag SET name = #{name}, parent_id = #{parentId}, is_tech_stack = #{isTechStack}, show_in_tech_map = #{showInTechMap}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag WHERE name = #{name}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tag WHERE name = #{name} AND id != #{id}
